Career AI — Job Search Assistant — Overview
Career AI is a full stack web app built by Thariq.
It helps with job search: skills, job matching, interview prep and application tracking.
The code is public at github.com/thariqdev/career-ai.

Career AI — Job Search Assistant — Tech stack
The frontend uses Next.js (App Router), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
The backend uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 and Alembic migrations.
The database is PostgreSQL.
Tests use pytest. CI runs on GitHub Actions.
It is hosted on Vercel, Render and Neon.

Career AI — Job Search Assistant — Proof-based skills
Each skill has a status: VERIFIED, PARTIAL, PROVISIONAL or NOT_VERIFIED.
A skill is only verified when there is evidence for it.

Career AI — Job Search Assistant — Job matching
Career AI compares a job description with the user's skills.
It lists the gaps between them.

Career AI — Job Search Assistant — RAG assistant
Career AI has a RAG assistant.
It uses hybrid retrieval: BM25 keyword search plus embeddings.
It also has read-only SQL tools.

Career AI — Job Search Assistant — AI models
Extraction can use a local Ollama model (llama3.2, nomic-embed-text) or Claude.
The AI models are optional.

Career AI — Job Search Assistant — Other features
It has interview prep and application tracking.

FundsApp — Mutual Fund Investment Platform — Overview
FundsApp is a fintech and wealth-management application.
Users sign up, complete KYC, get a risk profile, and then invest, including through SIPs.
Thariq worked on it at Evoqins Pvt Ltd.

FundsApp — Mutual Fund Investment Platform — Thariq's role
Thariq was a Software Engineer on FundsApp.
Most of his work was frontend, using React and Next.js.
He also contributed to the Python backend.
He built and worked with 15+ REST APIs.

FundsApp — Mutual Fund Investment Platform — Tech stack
The frontend uses React and Next.js.
The backend uses Python and FastAPI.
The database is PostgreSQL, accessed through SQLAlchemy.
Authentication uses JWT.
Thariq tested APIs with Postman and Swagger (OpenAPI).

FundsApp — Mutual Fund Investment Platform — Features
FundsApp covers partner and customer onboarding.
It covers authentication, KYC, investments and SIP management.
It also has risk profiling, client management, account lifecycle and account closure.
It has notification preferences.

FundsApp — Mutual Fund Investment Platform — Security
Authentication is JWT-based.
FundsApp also has MPIN-based security workflows.

FundsApp — Mutual Fund Investment Platform — SIPs
SIP means Systematic Investment Plan.
It is a fixed amount invested at regular intervals.
